lines.speaker: clerk_of_the_house
lines.text: Gallery is full, floor is closed, and if you are press you are late by about four hours.

lines.speaker: clerk_of_the_house
lines.text: Third reading of a private member's bill. It will pass on the nod, because forty members and none of them briefed against it.

lines.speaker: clerk_of_the_house
lines.text: You got into the lobby. There is no division list in there, because there was no division. Forty members and not one of them asked for one, and now there is a record of you asking.

lines.speaker: clerk_of_the_house
lines.text: You have read it. Nobody reads them. Go on then, what does it do.

lines.speaker: clerk_of_the_house
lines.text: Carried, with the naming clause. Eleven pages and one of them is now about who benefits. That is the most anyone has got out of this House in my time.

lines.speaker: clerk_of_the_house
lines.text: Withdrawn. And it will be back as a schedule to a finance act inside a year, which is the same bill with nobody watching. I have seen it four times.

lines.speaker: clerk_of_the_house
lines.text: You witnessed the register. Odd thing to want. It is a signature that outlives the signatory and most people find that unpleasant.
